spanish: Y cuando entraren a la tierra, y plantaren todo árbol de comida, y circuncidarán su prepucio, su fruto; tres años será a ustedes incircuncisos; no se comerá.

findings.issue: circuncidarán turns the qal foreskin-verb (lemma 6188) into circumcising (removing the foreskin). The packet’s cognates are the foreskin noun (6190) and the uncircumcised adjective (6189); the verb licenses treating its foreskin—its fruit—as uncircumcised.

entraren and plantaren sit inside the cuando clause, while circuncidarán is indicative. The two sequential perfects are the same morph class; the split makes planting only a circumstance and closes an open clause boundary.
findings.spanishSpan: cuando entraren a la tierra, y plantaren todo árbol de comida, y circuncidarán

findings.issue: cuando fixes the conjunction as temporal; the morph is only conjunction, so a conditional reading stays open.
entraren and plantaren are archaic future-subjunctive ustedes forms, not vosotros (entrareis/plantareis). Address stays 2pl.

notes: a ustedes, singular será with plural incircuncisos, and niphal no se comerá match the tokens.
